opportunities.title: Nuffield Farming Next-Gen Scholarship

amount.raw: The successful applicants will be awarded a Next-Gen Scholarship worth £6,000. The scholarship is fully funded including all travel and subsistence, plus a £1,000 financial incentive to part cover replacement labour cost.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Young people aged 18-24, resident in the UK, with a demonstrable interest in the farming industry (in 2027, dairy and pig study tours are planned).
opportunities.summary: A fully-funded 30-day study tour and development programme for young people (aged 18-24) to develop talent in the farming industry, linking successful applicants directly to farmers via the Nuffield Scholar network, including attendance at the Nuffield Conference and Nuffield Farming Associate membership.
